proposed_induced: Documents age-appropriate vital sign reference ranges and growth percentiles (for pediatric) or baseline functional/cognitive status (for geriatric).
Includes guardian/parental consent and history-taking involvement for patients under 18, or capacity assessment and advance directive review for patients over 65.
Specifies weight-based medication dosing for children, and reviews polypharmacy/anticoagulant status in older adults.
Uses age-adjusted clinical scoring systems (e.g., Pediatric GCS) and considers age-specific red flags (e.g., non-accidental trauma in children, atypical shock presentation in elderly).
